notes.title: Patch 1.3.4 is LIVE
notes.content:
Greetings Brave Souls,

We've been hard at work with some small changes and fixes that have been shared by our community. We're listening to everyone that's reached out and communicated the issues they've noticed. Your feedback and keen eyes are greatly appreciated.

We're including our patch notes below so you know everything touched in this patch. Thank you so much for your continued interest and support.

Cheers,
The Elderand Team

[b]PATCH NOTE (VERSION 1.3.4)[/b]

[b]Bugs/Issues:[/b]

-Fixed missing title text on relics collecting.
-Fixed text spacing overlapping in some languages on the title screen.
-Fixed text missing on dialogue box in some languages.
-Fixed the Glowing Ring's incorrect special power description.
-Fixed missing background on a section of Omulore harbor.
-Fixed several sprite issues on Forest of Exhausted
-Fixed several sprite issues on Akr-Sharrak
-Fixed Chain-Lighnting stopping mid-air.
-Fixed Chain-Lightning not applying electric damage.
-Fixed Chain-Lightning getting smaller with time.
-Fixed slots disappearing when there’s an empty save.
-Fixed the incorrect immunity icons appearing on some enemies.
-Fixed some Insected Nest positions. 
-Fixed blocking not working sometimes on Black Virtue punch.
-Fixed blocking not working sometimes on Black Virtue feather shot.
-Fixed a blind spot on the Elderutamah boss fight.
-Fixed Sserthris not flipping during the combo.
-Fixed Torraka Hunter hitbox.

notes.title: The First Patch is LIVE
notes.content:
Greetings Brave Souls,

First of all, thank you, from the bottom of our hearts, for your support of Elderand! We poured our hearts into this game, and we're thrilled that it's resonating with so many of you.

That said, we're dedicated to continuing to make this experience the very best it can be. To that end, our first patch is now live. Take a look at the patch notes below to see what you can expect from this one. And know that we hear you, we're listening, and we're truly humbled by your support of our game.

Cheers,
The Elderand Team

PATCH NOTE (VERSION 1.3.2)

Bugs/Issues:

-Fixed the hit box for Dan’nuhrr, Erik Zan, Torturer of the benighted, Amon, and Unstoppable Brute.
-Fixed dialogue box’s text area being too small.
-Fixed notes showing ‘Max’ in Cathedral.
-Fixed snakes not spawning properly in the Sanctuary of the First.
-Fixed Getzansu’s weapon switch glitch.
-Fixed Arena’s popup window showing wrong text.
-Fixed Pollo’s cave shop not updating properly.
-Fixed secondary weapon’s text overflowing in the equipment menu in italian.
-Fixed Dan’nuhrr’s hitbox not being deactivated on fake faces.
-Fixed Sserthris leaving map when dodging.
-Fixed inconsistent current value when previewing the ability increase.
-Fixed Elderutamah’s wrong dialogue.
-Fixed several achievements not working.
-Fixed special move inputs not working with joystick.
-Fixed Auvit’Evit’s arrows stopping bug.
-Fixed german glyphs missing (Ä, ä, Ö, ö, Ü, ü).
-Fixed incorrect translations.
-Fixed Temple’s roof trap sometimes getting stuck.
-Fixed Eloria’s roots attack sound being too loud.
-Fixed Black Virtue’s shockwave sounds missing.
-Fixed Elderutamah’s intro cutscene with sounds missing.
-Fixed Player not going to the shield state if pressed before taking a damage.
-Fixed gas hitbox not working.
-Fixed Endless Lands’s trap bug.
-Fixed spawning enemies bug in Arena and forest’s hives.
-Fixed rebinding buttons bug.
-Sound was created for the corruption’s smoke in the cutscenes.
-Added rumble to player’s death and triple gargoyle’s cutscene.
-Hideous Disciplinarian behavior update: stop following player if close enough.
-Indoctrinated Scout behavior update: stop following player if close enough.
-Indoctrinated Soldier behavior update: stop following player if close enough.
-Indoctrinated Lancer behavior update: stop following player if close enough.
-Sadic Tutor behavior update: stop following player if close enough.
-Updated Fallen Presbyter behavior: after the close scythe attack, he moves up.

Balancing:

Enemies and Bosses

-Updated Sserthris’s HP.
-Updated Erik Zan’s HP and behavior.
-Updated Elderutamah’s HP and behavior.
-Updated Amon’s HP.
-Updated Black Virtue’s HP and behavior.
-Updated Dan’nuhrr’s HP.
-Updated Torturer of the benighted’s behavior and attack damage.
-Updated Pseudopod Horror’s attack damage.

Items

-Updated all staffs damage and mana cost.
-Updated Studded Whip damage and special damage.
-Updated Kor'ydal the snake damage.
-Updated Razshah, the only special damage.
-Updated Small Health potion.
-Updated Large Health potion.
-Updated Large Mana potion.
-Updated Axe Sub-Weapon damage scale.
-Updated Knife Sub-Weapon damage scale.
-Increased Sumptuous ring drop rating.

Features

-vSync Video options.
-Now you can use sub-weapons with a single button, also remap the button.
-Sub-weapon’s classic mode can be turned On/Off.

notes.title: Elderand Launches February 16th!
notes.content:
Greetings Warriors,

We're excited to announce that Elderand will officially launch February 16th, 2023! Soon you can journey into the darkness of Elderand, where you’ll wield a variety of killing instruments and abilities against towering, bone-chilling bosses. If you haven't already, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1413660/Elderand/]Wishlist Elderand[/url] today to receive an alert when the game is ready to purchase and play. 

Customize your battle experience from appearance to skills, stats, weapons and collect loot as you travel to the many corners of its detailed hand-drawn pixel world with glorious gothic aesthetics and handcrafted Lovecraftian level design.

In celebration of this announcement, you can check out our Launch Date Trailer to get a
little peek at what’s in store.

[previewyoutube=hwxhOV-b50Y;full][/previewyoutube]

To keep up with the latest development updates, follow us on [url=https://discord.com/invite/GfXD6Se]Discord[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/Elderandgame]Twitter[/url], and [url=https://www.facebook.com/gaming/Elderand/]Facebook[/url].

Calling all fearless warriors!

We’re opening up the dangerous world of Elderand to a few brave playtesters. We need your help to hunt down bugs, uncover any hidden balancing issues, and hone in on anything else you‘d like to provide feedback on so that we can make this game as strong as possible for you.

If you’d like to join the adventure, please head to the link below to join the official Elderand Discord.

[url=https://discord.com/invite/GfXD6Se]>>APPLY HERE<<[/url]

We’re using the Elderand Discord to notify those who are selected for the playtest and for feedback collection. The playtest will run for one week, so be sure to get in your request to the playtesting channel as soon as possible.

While you’re at it, please consider following Elderand on [url=https://twitter.com/Elderandgame]Twitter[/url] and [url=https://www.facebook.com/gaming/Elderand/]Facebook [/url]for all the latest development updates.

Happy Hunting,
The Elderand Team

notes.title: Enter Our Lovecraftian Nightmare Art Contest!
notes.content:
Hi all, 

Halloween is around the corner and to celebrate, we're holding a Lovecraftian Nightmare art contest! We can't wait to see all the amazing characters you will draw. 

Here's what you'll need to do. Create a Lovecraftian inspired monster similar to the ones seen in Elderand. The grand prize winner will have their monster as an Easter egg in Elderand and receive a copy of the game when it's released. Bonus winners will also receive a game code. You can submit your drawing any time from October 25 - October 31 on the Elderand [url=https://discord.com/invite/SkEXvsJEsJ]Discord[/url] or on Twitter. 

Details
[list]
[*] How to enter: Draw a Lovecraftian inspired monster that could be straight out of the world of Elderand. Submit your art in the submissions channel on Elderand’s [url=https://discord.com/invite/SkEXvsJEsJ]Discord[/url] or on Twitter using the contest hashtag #LovecraftxElderand.
[*] Rules: Character must appear in portrait orientation. Must resemble Lovecraft inspired monsters. Must be submitted by 11:59 p.m. PST on October 31, 2021. No inappropriate drawings.  
[*] Contest Start Date: October 25 at 10 a.m. PST
[/list]

[previewyoutube=_C3jqMlhu44;full][/previewyoutube]

If you haven't already, join the Elderand [url=https://discord.com/invite/SkEXvsJEsJ]Discord[/url] or follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/elderandgame]Twitter[/url].

Cheers,
Mantra and Graffiti Games
